purpose: Saturation/inhibition AND validation with varied pulse trains and fair reference baselines

inference_timing_500_examples_seconds.warning: Not a hardware speedup claim: Python event loops and Torch kernels differ in batching/vectorization and overhead.

reference_validation.note: The independent recurrence is used for numerical cross-check. Brian2 was unavailable in this offline runtime and was not executed.

external_simulator.name: Brian2
external_simulator.reason: Brian2 is not installed and package installation was blocked by unavailable network access in this runtime.
external_simulator.fallback: Independent exact-discrete recurrence cross-check is provided; Brian2 parity remains an open validation item.

limits: The pulse AND cell has manually specified parameters; this experiment validates the mechanism and dynamics, not learned weights.
The temporal MLP is trained on 5000 examples; the pulse circuit is configured analytically, so this is not an equal-training-budget learning comparison.
The analytic coincidence rule is an oracle for the task definition, not a learned model.
A later experiment will train a network sequentially on synchrony then A-before-B and compare reward-modulated STDP with a same-order MLP baseline.
